input: Stitch iron-on patches onto my denim jacket

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many patches and whether they cover damage or are purely decorative changes how much prep work and stitching is needed.
Whether this is for themselves or as a gift affects how precise or personalised the result needs to be.
Whether the patches have already been ironed on or are starting from scratch determines the first steps of the process.
Access to a sewing machine versus hand-stitching only changes the technique, thread type, and time required entirely.
The desired stitch style (invisible, blanket stitch, decorative running stitch) directly shapes which instructions to follow and the final look.
Knowing whether the priority is durability (e.g. for heavy wear) or aesthetics (neat, polished look) determines how thoroughly to stitch and what thread to use.
Knowing the user's sewing experience level determines how detailed and beginner-friendly the step-by-step plan needs to be.

gold.taskTitle: Stitch iron-on patches onto denim jacket
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to permanently attach iron-on patches to their denim jacket using stitching, likely to reinforce or customise it.

questions.title: How many patches are you adding to the jacket?
questions.description: Understanding the quantity of patches helps determine the scope of the task and how much time and thread to budget.

questions.title: Who is this jacket being customised for?
questions.description: Knowing if it is for the user personally or someone else affects how tailored and precise the placement and finish needs to be.

questions.title: Have the patches already been ironed on, or not yet?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan starts with ironing instructions or skips straight to the stitching steps.

questions.title: Will you be hand-stitching or using a sewing machine?
questions.description: The available tools completely change the technique, thread weight, needle type, and instructions provided.

questions.title: What stitch style do you want around the patches?
questions.description: The preferred stitch (e.g. blanket stitch, running stitch, invisible stitch) shapes the visual outcome and the instructions to follow.

questions.title: Is your main priority durability or a clean aesthetic finish?
questions.description: This determines how densely to stitch, what thread type to recommend, and how much reinforcement to add at patch edges.

questions.title: How confident are you with basic sewing techniques?
questions.description: The user's experience level decides how detailed and step-by-step the instructions need to be.
